title: What an agent points a running viewer at
description: Written to .o3j-view/highlight.json by render view=highlight; open3dj view checks it against this schema and the revision, and sends it to the page, which highlights the targets and frames them.

target.description: The target as the agent gave it.

element.description: A face target: face:<n> on each of paths.

note.description: A short message from the agent, shown as text next to the highlight.

truncated.description: True when the targets named more than 2000 occurrences and the rest were left out.
